text: My money is my money, and your money is our money. You hear this narrative more and more lately. TikTok, Instagram, podcasts, female influencers, even celebrities are pushing it. And today I want to talk about what is wrong with this statement from my point of view. You see, at its core, this argument is really about how finances and, generally speaking, responsibilities should work in a relationship. Should it be 50-50, 70-30, 100-0? In my opinion, none of the above. A healthy relationship should be 100-200. What do I mean by that? You see, in a relationship, two people form one team, one social unit, if you will. And both should contribute everything they reasonably can, their 100%. Of course, that 100% doesn't look the same. If a man works more and earns more, he will likely carry more of the financial load. The woman might contribute more in other areas, home, organization, support, creating a good atmosphere. And to be fair to the ladies, it can also be the other way around. In a weird way, a good relationship follows the communist slogan of Karl Marx, from each according to their ability to each according to their needs. Now here's where the problem starts. When a woman treats your money as our money, but her money as my money, she is no longer contributing her 100%. She is opting out of the team. And in my book, that cannot lead to a healthy relationship. A woman who genuinely cares about you will always try to contribute something. Even if you bring in 90% of the income and she brings in only 10, she will still do small things. Buy some groceries, cover something on the way home, help where she can. Not because you asked, but because she wants to. When someone is comfortable taking everything, but giving nothing back, that's not your partner in crime. That's not your ride or die girl. That is not your you-two-against-the-world woman. That's just a lack of empathy, care, respect, and honestly, love towards you. So the question is simple. Why stay with someone who expects 100% from you, but refuses to give 100% in return? Find a partner who gives 100% to your 100%.
